title: stenostomum jamaicense

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Stenostomum jamaicense include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects.
